ns2:course.label: Comp Politics in Dev Nations
ns2:course.description: Provides comparative and historical insights into the problems affecting the developing world by examining social, economic and political changes in Africa, Asia, and Latin America.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Non-Western Cultures, and Social Sciences course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one discussion and one lecture section.
